segments.title: Keys walk clockwise
segments.learningGoal: Each key belongs to the next server clockwise.
segments.visualPlan: Ring world: keys, then servers, then a walk.

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Put eight keys on a ring, then two servers, A at 3 and B at 7.

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Key 1 walks clockwise and stops at A. Every key does the same walk.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: So what happens when server C joins at 5?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Only keys 4 and 5 move, from B to C. The rest stay.

segments.title: Mod versus ring
segments.learningGoal: Mod N moves most keys; the ring moves one arc.
segments.visualPlan: Compare: table for mod, shared ring for the ring.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: And with mod 2 going to mod 3?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Mod moves 4 of 8 keys. The ring moved 2 of 8.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: And the loads stay close to even.
